cognoscĭbĭlis , e, adj. cognosco,
I.recognizable, discernible (late Lat.), Boëth. Arist. Anal. Post. 1, 541.—Adv.: cogno-scĭbĭlĭter , recognizably: “a magnitudine creaturae cognoscibiliter poterit creator videri,” Vulg. Sap. 13, 5 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
